name: France

geography.notes: Use the dated COG, retaining COM as a string (Corsican 2A/2B and overseas forms) and TYPECOM/COMPARENT relationships. Metropolitan rural communes, Corsica and overseas territories form explicit strata; overseas market/territory assignment must be declared, never silently dropped or folded into metropolitan coverage. Alsace and border areas get German alias queries; no .fr, language or SIREN-to-POS inference.

strategies.notes: After field/privacy admission, filter a dated local extract at establishment (SIRET) level and preserve SIREN as a separate legal unit. Activity codes are candidate signals; include secondary retail activities and small repair shops. Check code-version changes rather than hardcoding a timeless NAF definition. Open_data describes a possible route; no data downloaded here.

Plan commune and rural hamlet aliases with service/retail POIs from an admitted dated local OSM extract. Do not use public Nominatim for exhaustive queries. A COG geography denominator is not a business denominator.

Explore professions and departmental localities, especially independent repairers, used dealers and motorcycle specialists. Recyclers require saleable/reparable whole-vehicle evidence; parts inventory alone is excluded.

Motorhome-specific distribution directory reaches specialists missed by generic garages. Distinguish powered campers from caravans and rental-only operators; non-listed micro converters remain candidates.
Trace concessionnaires and agents, including rural service branches, with POS evidence. Renault does not cover independent dealers or other marques; observed service status is not proof of inventory.

Keep four category paths separate when later admitted, preserving private publishers and professional-account claims without auto-creating dealers. Caravaning includes non-powered assets that need filtering. No free API assumed.
Independent portal evidence may overlap other portals and syndication; retain publisher provenance and compare owned websites. No inventory enumeration or bulk permission established.
Combine rural locality names, anciens noms and border-language queries. Include one-vehicle and unknown-stock workshops; local listings require activity evidence.

Authored search recipes seek owned sites and hosted inventory. Use the archive URL index only after candidate domain discovery, never send full-text queries as CDX requests. Check current evidence before considering archive businesses active.
Review public professional referrals without login bypass. Overseas and rural web-less sellers remain visible as discovery debt; content access and reuse need independent admission.

sources.access_notes: Versioned commune catalogue with parent-commune links; distinguish current communes, delegated communes and municipal arrondissements.

sources.title: Insee: consulter et télécharger Sirene
sources.access_notes: Free establishment and legal-unit identity channels; stock files, API and Annuaire have distinct surfaces and limits.

sources.title: data.gouv.fr: API Sirene and diffusion restrictions
sources.access_notes: Partially disseminated personal information must not be fully republished or used for prospecting. Preserve diffusion status and admit only needed fields.

sources.title: Mobilians: annuaire professionnel
sources.access_notes: Public profession and locality directory. Workshops, recyclers and association membership are not stock or full-market proof.

sources.title: Camping-car Magazine: professional distribution directory
sources.access_notes: Publisher's own directory for motorhome professionals, distinct from the automotive registry. Public access does not establish reuse permission.

sources.title: Renault France: trouver un établissement
sources.access_notes: Manufacturer locator includes distribution and service establishments; identify each branch and observed capability.

sources.title: leboncoin: public categories and professional referrals
sources.access_notes: Observed separate voitures, motos, caravaning and utilitaires categories; private and professional advertisers coexist. No automated access granted.

sources.title: La Centrale: vehicle marketplace
sources.access_notes: Public website observed; seller identities and market/vehicle location need their own evidence, permissions and surface checks.

sources.title: PagesJaunes: professional locality directory
sources.access_notes: Local directory observed; membership, paid placement and service-only firms bias results. Automated extraction remains unapproved.

sources.title: OpenStreetMap copyright and licence
sources.access_notes: ODbL and attribution obligations must be assessed before use of a dated local extract; no country completeness claim.

sources.title: OSMF public Nominatim usage policy
sources.access_notes: Public Nominatim forbids systematic locality/grid/all-POI queries. It is not an exhaustive discovery backend.

sources.title: Common Crawl URL index
sources.access_notes: Free URL archive index, not full-text search. Bound exact-domain lookups; bulk filtering belongs on local index data with resource budget. Archive results are historical leads.

sources.title: Meta explanation of automated collection restrictions
sources.access_notes: Prior permission is required for automated collection. This channel is manual public business-page lead review only, without account creation or login bypass.

blind_spots: SIREN identifies a legal unit; SIRET an establishment, neither proves that digital vehicle inventory is published.
Diffusion restrictions and activity misclassification create legitimate unknowns; do not recover hidden personal fields from another source.
Rural hamlets, merged/delegated communes and suburban industrial estates need alias mapping to the dated COG.
Corsica, overseas territories and border-language coverage must be reported separately when locality files or access are missing.
Manufacturer agents and association members omit independent sellers; portal results omit sellers publishing only on their own pages.
One-vehicle/unknown-stock sellers stay in scope. Vocabulary is an authored search aid; regional-language/creole refinements remain open.
